## Common WHERE Filters

### 最常用分区过滤 (几乎100%查询)
```sql
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### 商品目标类型 + 用户过滤 (～90%查询)
```sql
  AND target_type = 'item'
  AND user_id > 0
```

### 平台过滤 (～40%查询)
```sql
  AND platform in ('ios_app', 'android_app')
```

### 搜索功能入口过滤 (～30%查询)
```sql
  AND feature_detail in ('global_search-item', 'search_in_pdp-item', 'search_in_subcategory-item')
```

### 搜索入口 + AB实验排除 (fill_rate 场景)
```sql
  AND feature_group = 'Search'
  AND feature_detail in ('global_search-item')
  AND get_full_signature_udf(split(ab_test, '@')[1]) != 'DS2'
```

### 多区域组合 + 跨日分区 (～15%查询, rcmd/budget_rcmd 场景)
```sql
  AND grass_region in ('TW','MY','PH','SG','TH','ID','VN','BR','MX','CO','CL')
  AND grass_date = '${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,"yyyy-MM-dd","-1d")}'
```

### request_id + location 联动过滤 (fill_rate/recall_rate 场景)
```sql
  AND request_id is not null
  AND location >= 0 AND location <= 300
```
> 用于 LEFT JOIN ads_slot_mapping 计算 adslot 覆盖/填充率时，确保 location 在有效范围内。

## Common JOIN Patterns

### 1. JOIN item_order_events (Click→Order 归因)
```sql
FROM mp_foa.dwd_eventid_click_last_di__reg_s0_live click
LEFT JOIN mp_foa.dwd_eventid_item_order_events_di__reg_s0_live ord
ON click.grass_region = ord.grass_region
  AND click.user_id = ord.user_id
  AND click.item_id = ord.item_id
  AND click.request_id = ord.request_id
  AND click.is_ads = ord.is_ads
```

### 2. JOIN adslot mapping (填充率计算)
```sql
FROM (
  SELECT ... FROM mp_foa.dwd_eventid_click_last_di__reg_s0_live ...
) click
LEFT JOIN ads_slot
ON click.grass_region = ads_slot.grass_region
  AND click.location = ads_slot.location
WHERE click.request_id is not null
  AND click.location >= 0 AND click.location <= 300
```

### 3. JOIN item_info (recall_rate: 关联商品元数据)
```sql
FROM (
  SELECT ... grass_region, keyword, user_id, item_id, SUM(1) AS organic_item_click_cnt
  FROM mp_foa.dwd_eventid_click_last_di__reg_s0_live ...
  GROUP BY ...
) click
LEFT JOIN mp_item.dim_item__reg_s0_live item
ON click.item_id = item.item_id
  AND click.grass_region = item.grass_region
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live ads_flag
ON click.item_id = ads_flag.item_id
  AND click.grass_region = ads_flag.grass_region
```
> recall_rate 场景：将自然流量商品点击与商品元数据（名称、类目、品牌）和广告状态（是否有广告、是否活跃）关联。

## Common Aggregations

### 基础点击计数 (item-level)
```sql
SELECT
    shop_id,
    item_id,
    COUNT(*) AS item_click_cnt
FROM mp_foa.dwd_eventid_click_last_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_date = '${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND target_type = 'item'
  AND user_id > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### 广告/自然点击分流
```sql
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(
        get_json_object(get_json_object(data_property, '$.common_params'), '$.is_ads'),
        get_json_object(get_json_object(data_property, '$.search_params.search_info'), '$.is_ads'),
        'false'
    ) = 'false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS organic_click_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(
        get_json_object(get_json_object(data_property, '$.common_params'), '$.is_ads'),
        get_json_object(get_json_object(data_property, '$.search_params.search_info'), '$.is_ads'),
        'false'
    ) = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ads_click_cnt
FROM mp_foa.dwd_eventid_click_last_di__reg_s0_live
...
```

### 关键词维度聚合 (fill_rate)
```sql
SELECT
    grass_region,
    user_id,
    keyword,
    request_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = 'true' AND is_ads_slot = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS req_type,
    SUM(1) AS total_click_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ads_click_cnt
FROM (
    SELECT ... FROM mp_foa.dwd_eventid_click_last_di__reg_s0_live ...
) t1
GROUP BY grass_region, user_id, keyword, request_id
```

### Entry Point 分类点击 (CASE-WHEN)
```sql
SELECT
    CASE WHEN page_type = 'fruit_store' THEN 'Daily Discover'
         WHEN feature_group = 'Search'
              AND feature_detail IN ('global_search-item', 'search_in_pdp-item',
                  'search_in_subcategory-item', 'search_in_mall-item', 'search-item')
              THEN 'Search'
         WHEN feature_group = 'Search' THEN 'Search Others'
         ELSE feature_group
    END AS entry_point,
    COUNT(1) AS click_cnt
FROM mp_foa.dwd_eventid_click_last_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE target_type = 'item'
  AND user_id > 0
GROUP BY 1
```

```sql
where   grass_date = date('${grass_date}')

```

### 3. RCMD click: item_id+shop_id 提取
```sql
select
    cast(coalesce(get_json_object(data,'$.itemid'),
                  get_json_object(data,'$.item.itemid')) as bigint) as item_id,
    cast(coalesce(get_json_object(data,'$.shopid'),
                  get_json_object(data,'$.item.shopid')) as bigint) as shop_id,
    count(1) as click_cnt,
    feature_group,
    grass_region,
    date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,"yyyy-MM-dd","-1d")}') as grass_date
from mp_foa.dwd_eventid_click_last_di__reg_s0_live
where tz_type = 'local'
  and grass_region in ('TW','MY','PH','SG','TH','ID','VN','BR','MX','CO','CL')
  and grass_date = '${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,"yyyy-MM-dd","-1d")}'
  and target_type = 'item'
  and user_id > 0

```

### 4. Organic CVR: 按小时+设备拆分 click/order
```sql
select  grass_region
        ,grass_date
        ,hour(from_unixtime(click_timestamp)) as regional_hour
        ,cast(json_extract(json_extract(data, '$["item"]'), '$["itemid"]') as bigint) as item_id
        ,user_id
        ,if(json_extract(json_extract_scalar(data, '$["search_info"]'), '$["is_ads"]') is null,
            'false',
            cast(json_extract(json_extract_scalar(data, '$["search_info"]'), '$["is_ads"]') as varchar)
          ) as is_ads
        ,json_extract(json_extract_scalar(data, '$["search_info"]'), '$["request_id"]') as request_id
        ,count(1) as click
from    mp_foa.dwd_eventid_click_last_di__reg_s0_live
where   grass_date = date('2023-03-28')
  and   tz_type = 'local'
  and   grass_region in ('ID')
  and   feature_group = 'Search'
  and   feature_detail in ('global_search-item')
  and   user_id > 0
group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
```

### 5. Entry Point 流量对比 (BI Tracking)
```sql
select  grass_date, grass_region,
        case when page_type = 'fruit_store' then 'Daily Discover'
             when feature_group = 'Search'
                  and feature_detail in ('global_search-item', 'search_in_pdp-item',
                      'search_in_subcategory-item', 'search_in_mall-item', 'search-item')
                  then 'Search'
             when feature_group = 'Search' then 'Search Others'
             else feature_group
        end as entry_point,
        coalesce(json_extract_scalar(json_extract_scalar(data_property, '$.common_params'), '$.is_ads'),
                 json_extract_scalar(json_extract_scalar(data_property, '$.search_params.search_info'), '$.is_ads'),
                 'false') as is_ads,
        1 as click_cnt
from    mp_foa.dwd_eventid_click_last_di__reg_s0_live
where   target_type = 'item'
  and   grass_date = date('2023-02-10')
  and   grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
  and   user_id > 0
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

### is_ads 分流标记 (data_property 路径，主模式)
```sql
coalesce(
    get_json_object(get_json_object(data_property, '$.common_params'), '$.is_ads'),
    get_json_object(get_json_object(data_property, '$.search_params.search_info'), '$.is_ads'),
    'false'
) as is_ads
```
> 出现模式: 40+ files，用于所有需要区分广告/自然流量的场景。优先取 `common_params.is_ads`，其次 `search_params.search_info.is_ads`。

### is_ads 提取 (data 列 search_info 路径，备选)
```sql
if(json_extract(json_extract_scalar(data, '$["search_info"]'), '$["is_ads"]') is null,
    'false',
    cast(json_extract(json_extract_scalar(data, '$["search_info"]'), '$["is_ads"]') as varchar)
) as is_ads
```
> 出现模式: 3+ files，从 `data` 列直接提取 `search_info.is_ads`，用于 CVR/offline 分析场景（icey.li 的 organic_trend 任务）。

### 时区小时提取
```sql
hour(from_unixtime(click_timestamp)) as regional_hour
```
> 出现模式: 3+ files，将 click_timestamp (Unix timestamp) 转为本地时区小时，用于按小时粒度的 CVR 分析。

### entry_point 分类 (feature_group → entry_point 映射)
```sql
CASE WHEN page_type = 'fruit_store' THEN 'Daily Discover'
     WHEN feature_group = 'Search'
          AND feature_detail IN ('global_search-item', 'search_in_pdp-item',
              'search_in_subcategory-item', 'search_in_mall-item', 'search-item')
          THEN 'Search'
     WHEN feature_group = 'Search' THEN 'Search Others'
     ELSE feature_group
END as entry_point
```
> 出现模式: 3+ files，将 feature_group+feature_detail 映射为业务可读的 entry_point。

### Organic Click (自然点击识别)
```sql
SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = 'false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS organic_click_cnt
```
> 出现模式: 15+ files，基于 is_ads 标记分离自然流量点击。

### Item ID 提取 (兼容两种 JSON 路径)
```sql
CAST(COALESCE(
    get_json_object(data, '$.itemid'),
    get_json_object(data, '$.item.itemid')
) AS BIGINT) AS item_id
```
> 出现模式: 10+ files，兼容直接 `itemid` 和嵌套 `item.itemid` 两种 JSON 结构。
